def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seed = next(((i, j) for i, row in enumerate(grid) for j, v in enumerate(row) if v == 3), None)
    if seed is None:
        return out
    r, c = seed
    # Draw an expanding square spiral, starting upward. Existing 2s stop the path;
    # grid edges do not, so later spiral segments may re-enter the grid.
    dirs = [(-1, 0), (0, 1), (1, 0), (0, -1)]
    length = 2
    d = 0
    for _ in range(200):
        dr, dc = dirs[d % 4]
        for _ in range(length):
            r += dr
            c += dc
            if 0 <= r < h and 0 <= c < w:
                if grid[r][c] == 2:
                    return out
                out[r][c] = 3
        d += 1
        if d % 2 == 0:
            length += 2
    return out
